Entity.name: Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
Entity.commentInRDBMS: Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is a Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument where the applicable accounting standard in national GAAP.

Attribute.name: Haircuts for trading position valued at fair value
Attribute.comment: Haircut for trading position valued at fair value for the Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) According to Annex V (5.29): Where applicable under national GAAP based on BAD, ‘Haircuts for trading positions valued at fair value’ shall be reported. The haircuts decrease the value of trading assets and increase the value of trading liabilities.
